verdict.rationale: Browser Use is built around handing an agent a natural-language goal and having it finish the task. The docs show `client.runs.create("Find the top Hacker News story")` and describe how to "give a high-accuracy browser agent a goal and get the result," and the GitHub README gives a form-filling example ("Fill in this job application with my resume"). A community user reports multi-step clicking flows working hands-on, sending LinkedIn friend requests and answering messages. Sessions let multiple runs reuse a live browser for longer flows. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of reliability on complex form-filling and click-through flows (no success-rate or benchmark data in the pack).
